task: Merge dual progress trackers (prerequisite banner and macro phase stepper) and integrate the pending proposal deliberation state, locked chapters notification, and Approval Studio action directly into a single unified CapstoneWorkflowStepper component.

quality_gate_battery.targeted_unit_tests: 11/11 passed (CapstoneWorkflowStepper.test.jsx & MyProjectPage.test.jsx) and 97/97 component tests passed

lessons_learned.lesson: Rendering separate prerequisite step banners (e.g., Submit Title -> Get Approved) alongside macro capstone milestone progress steppers creates confusing duplicate progress bars and fragments the page with multiple stacked cards. Consolidating the title proposal as an explicit 1st-class milestone in the macro workflow creates a cohesive 5-stage pipeline with 1-click tab switching.
lessons_learned.prevention: Never stack multiple progress trackers or standalone alert cards above a workflow page. Embed contextual deliberation banners, gating notices, and candidate preview trays directly within the authoritative stepper component.
